entries.title: Jeremiah 10:1
segments: ¶Hear the word which the LORD speaks to you, O house of Israel.

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:2
segments: Thus says the LORD: "Do not learn the way of the Gentiles; Do not be dismayed at the signs of heaven, For the Gentiles are dismayed at them.

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:3
segments: For the customs of the peoples [are] futile; For [one] cuts a tree from the forest, The work of the hands of the workman, with the ax.

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:4
segments: They decorate it with silver and gold; They fasten it with nails and hammers So that it will not topple.

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:5
segments: They [are] upright, like a palm tree, And they cannot speak; They must be carried, Because they cannot go [by themselves]. Do not be afraid of them, For they cannot do evil, Nor can they do any good."

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:6
segments: Inasmuch as [there is] none like You, O LORD (You [are] great, and Your name [is] great in might),

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:7
segments: Who would not fear You, O King of the nations? For this is Your rightful due. For among all the wise [men] of the nations, And in all their kingdoms, [There is] none like You.

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:8
segments: But they are altogether dull-hearted and foolish; A wooden idol [is] a worthless doctrine.

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:9
segments: Silver is beaten into plates; It is brought from Tarshish, And gold from Uphaz, The work of the craftsman And of the hands of the metalsmith; Blue and purple [are] their clothing; They [are] all the work of skillful [men].

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:10
segments: But the LORD [is] the true God; He [is] the living God and the everlasting King. At His wrath the earth will tremble, And the nations will not be able to endure His indignation.

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:11
segments: Thus you shall say to them: "The gods that have not made the heavens and the earth shall perish from the earth and from under these heavens."

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:12
segments: He has made the earth by His power, He has established the world by His wisdom, And has stretched out the heavens at His discretion.

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:13
segments: When He utters His voice, [There is] a multitude of waters in the heavens: "And He causes the vapors to ascend from the ends of the earth. He makes lightning for the rain, He brings the wind out of His treasuries."

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:14
segments: Everyone is dull-hearted, without knowledge; Every metalsmith is put to shame by an image; For his molded image [is] falsehood, And [there is] no breath in them.

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:15
segments: They [are] futile, a work of errors; In the time of their punishment they shall perish.

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:16
segments: The Portion of Jacob [is] not like them, For He [is] the Maker of all [things], And Israel [is] the tribe of His inheritance; The LORD of hosts [is] His name.

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:17
segments: ¶Gather up your wares from the land, O inhabitant of the fortress!

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:18
segments: For thus says the LORD: "Behold, I will throw out at this time The inhabitants of the land, And will distress them, That they may find [it so]."

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:19
segments: Woe is me for my hurt! My wound is severe. But I say, "Truly this [is] an infirmity, And I must bear it."

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:20
segments: My tent is plundered, And all my cords are broken; My children have gone from me, And they [are] no more. [There is] no one to pitch my tent anymore, Or set up my curtains.

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:21
segments: For the shepherds have become dull-hearted, And have not sought the LORD; Therefore they shall not prosper, And all their flocks shall be scattered.

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:22
segments: Behold, the noise of the report has come, And a great commotion out of the north country, To make the cities of Judah desolate, a den of jackals.

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:23
segments: O LORD, I know the way of man [is] not in himself; [It is] not in man who walks to direct his own steps.

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:24
segments: O LORD, correct me, but with justice; Not in Your anger, lest You bring me to nothing.

entries.title: Jeremiah 10:25
segments: Pour out Your fury on the Gentiles, who do not know You, And on the families who do not call on Your name; For they have eaten up Jacob, Devoured him and consumed him, And made his dwelling place desolate.
